limitations: This is the fixed 122-view selected fast Axe audit; it is not a complete 530-view Lighthouse sweep.
All current outcomes and every bounded numeric palette phase/sample/event are preserved; no prior failure is waived or reclassified.
Automatic violations, incomplete, passes and inapplicable remain distinct. Incomplete node occurrences are not unique defects and require manual review.
Zero automatic violations does not establish complete accessibility conformance, natural Tab order or every keyboard workflow.
The new palette observer retains normal motion and observes bounded stability; it does not establish the cause of historical restoration failures.
Cleanup is the recorded terminal observation for this cohort, not a statement about later fixture/session state.
Private text, HTML, node selectors and fixture/runtime identities remain in the originals. Rule identifiers and aggregated node/check counts are retained.
This offline projection performs no browser, HTTP, SQL, new accessibility analysis, Lighthouse scoring or field INP measurement.
